Brief Description of Requirements: Provision Azure production foundation for 3 environments (DEV, UAT, PROD), including 3 resource groups, naming standards, tagging policy, region selection, baseline monitoring hooks, and environment separation.

Configure virtual network topology for 3 environments, including 3 VNets or segmented subnets, private endpoint subnet, integration subnet, NSG rules, and route table baseline for Azure-hosted services.

Set up Azure API Management as the API gateway for DEV, UAT, and PROD, including 3 gateway instances or environment-separated products, inbound policies, JWT validation, throttling, and backend routing.
Set up Azure Key Vault for 3 environments, including separate vaults, managed identity access, secret naming conventions, rotation ownership, and references from application configuration.

Configure Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server across DEV, UAT, and PROD, including database creation, firewall/private access, backup retention, connection pooling assumptions, and baseline performance tier sizing.
Set up Azure Storage for 3 environments, including document upload container, processing artifact container, diagnostic log container, lifecycle retention, and private access configuration.

Configure Azure OpenAI or model endpoint access for 3 environments, including deployment references, private access where available, managed identity usage, quota checks, and content filtering baseline.
Implement Entra ID authentication integration for the upgraded SYC portal, including 1 enterprise app registration, redirect URIs for 3 environments, token validation, and logout handling.
Set up RBAC model for production operations, including 6 role groups (admin, case officer, approver, support, auditor, service principal) and least-privilege mappings to portal and Azure resources.
Configure managed identities and service principals for app, API gateway, database access, storage access, Key Vault access, and CI/CD deployment, with separate identities for DEV, UAT, and PROD.
Set up ShipHat/Azure DevOps repository structure and branching model, including main, develop, release, and hotfix branches plus pull request policy and reviewer rules.
Create CI pipeline for frontend and backend builds, including dependency restore, linting, unit test execution, build packaging, and artifact publication for 2 application components.
Create deployment pipelines to promote artifacts through DEV, UAT, and PROD, including environment approvals, variable groups, deployment gates, and rollback hooks.
Configure code scan stage in CI/CD, including static code scan, dependency vulnerability scan, secrets scan, license scan, and quality gate reporting; excludes VAPT by scope.
Implement infrastructure-as-code promotion for Azure resources across 3 environments, including parameter files, deployment validation, and environment-specific configuration overrides.
Upgrade existing SYC JavaScript portal shell, including navigation structure, environment-aware API configuration, authenticated route handling, shared layout, and production build configuration.
Upgrade portal case intake page, including 1 guided intake form, applicant details, case details, validation rules, autosave behavior, and API submission integration.
Upgrade portal document upload experience, including multi-file upload, progress display, supported file validation, retry handling, and storage-backed upload token flow.
Implement AI assistant side panel in the SYC portal, including session-only chat surface, action cards, findings summary, review prompts, and explicit user confirmation before case creation.
Implement case search and retrieval page, including search by case reference, applicant identifier, status, submission date range, and access-controlled result filtering.
Implement case detail page, including case metadata, document list, AI extraction summary, approval history, D365 write-back status, and audit event display.

Implement agentic orchestration service, including session creation, task routing, tool invocation control, action card generation, and guarded handoff between extraction, validation, approval, and write-back steps.

Implement document ingestion workflow, including upload registration, file metadata capture, virus-scan handoff placeholder, OCR/extraction trigger, and processing status update for each uploaded document.

Implement extraction and validation workflow, including mapping of extracted values to case fields, confidence scoring, required-field checks, cross-field validation, and exception flags for officer review.

Implement human approval workflow, including approval request creation, reviewer assignment, approve/reject decision capture, comments, timestamping, and prevention of D365 write-back before approval.

Implement agent metadata schema in Azure PostgreSQL, including tables for sequence records, tool runs, findings, approvals, audit events, and agent runs with hashes only for sensitive conversation references.
Migrate demo database objects into production-ready Azure PostgreSQL structure, including schema normalization, seed/reference data loading, migration scripts, and validation of row counts.
Implement API layer for portal-to-backend calls, including endpoints for case draft, document metadata, extraction result, approval action, search, and case detail retrieval.
Implement D365 on-prem case creation integration after approved case creation, including payload mapping, network route, retry handling, response capture, and error state logging.
Implement D365 on-prem write-back status reconciliation, including polling or callback handling, status mapping, retry threshold, and officer-visible failure reason.

Configure secure connectivity to existing services, including D365 on-prem endpoint, identity provider, notification service, and any existing SYC portal service dependency through approved network paths.
Implement notification integration for case submission, approval request, approval decision, and D365 write-back failure events using the existing enterprise notification service.
Implement application logging and audit trail, including correlation IDs, user action events, agent tool run events, approval events, integration events, and operational diagnostics.
Configure observability dashboards and alerts, including availability checks, API failure rate, D365 integration failure queue, database health, storage failures, and pipeline deployment status.
Implement data retention and archival job for uploaded documents, processing artifacts, and audit metadata according to agreed retention rules and environment-specific test data cleanup.

Implement backup and restore runbook validation, including Azure PostgreSQL backup review, storage recovery check, configuration export, and one restoration rehearsal for UAT before production cutover.
Create operational report for intake volume, processing status, approval turnaround, D365 write-back success, and exception count with filters by date, officer, and case status.
Create audit extract report for case events, approval decisions, integration events, and agent tool run metadata for compliance review and production support investigation.
Prepare system integration testing across portal, backend APIs, Azure PostgreSQL, storage, Key Vault, API Management, agent orchestration, notification service, and D365 on-prem integration.
Support UAT round 1, including test data preparation, environment smoke test, defect triage, daily support window, fixes promotion to UAT, and retest support.
Support UAT round 2, including regression test support, critical defect fixes, deployment rehearsal, user sign-off evidence capture, and go-live readiness tracking.
Prepare production cutover, including deployment checklist, release notes, rollback plan, production smoke test checklist, access verification, and stakeholder go/no-go coordination.
Perform production deployment through ShipHat/Azure DevOps, including approved release execution, database migration, configuration verification, smoke testing, and release evidence packaging.
Prepare production operations handover, including support runbook, monitoring guide, known issue register, deployment guide, access matrix, and integration troubleshooting notes.
